text:
Class 4 Driver (logistics, Pandan Loop, travel to ports). Full-time, long-term. Salary $3,800 to $4,600 monthly, including overtime, night and other allowances; training, year-end bonus and KPI incentive.
Requirements:
[R1] Valid Class 4 driving licence.
[R2] Experience in driving, delivery or logistics operations.
[R3] Willing to work day and night shifts, six days a week, with overtime.
[R4] PSA Pass, forklift licence, rigger/signalman certificate and SCDF HazMat certificate are an advantage.
[R5] Responsible and a good team player.
Apply through MyCareersFuture.

Requirements:

Part-Time Admin Assistant ($12-$15/hr | 2-3 weekdays/week). Company: YAN BUSINESS GROUP. Office, on-site at Alexandra Hill. Hours negotiable. Send resume; details explained at interview; shortlisted candidates only.

Requirements:
[R1] At least 2 years in warehouse or inventory operations.
[R2] Advanced Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP) for weekly stock reports.
[R3] Experience with a warehouse management system (WMS).
[R4] Forklift licence preferred.
[R5] Proven record of reducing picking errors.
[R6] Coordinate with drivers and the supply chain team.

Customer Service Executive at BrightHome Retail Pte Ltd (Jurong East). Full-time, rotating shifts. Be the first point of contact for customers across store, phone, email and chat.
Requirements:
[R1] At least 1 year of customer-facing experience.
[R2] Handle enquiries by phone, email and chat; CRM tools such as Zendesk are a plus.
[R3] Proven record of improving customer satisfaction scores.
[R4] Good spoken English; Mandarin is an advantage.
[R5] Handle cash and POS transactions for in-store returns.

Operations Executive at Meridian Supply Pte Ltd (Pasir Panjang). Full-time. Plan and track daily dispatch and delivery.
Requirements:

[R2] Plan and monitor daily dispatch and delivery routes.
[R3] Working knowledge of SAP or a similar ERP system.
[R4] Analyse delivery data in Excel to find delays.
[R5] Coordinate with the warehouse team and drivers.

Admin and Accounts Assistant at Lakeshore Trading Pte Ltd (Kallang). Full-time, office hours. Support the finance and general office team.
Requirements:
[R1] Experience with accounts payable, accounts receivable and invoicing.
[R2] Xero or QuickBooks.
[R3] Intermediate Excel (formulas, VLOOKUP).
[R4] Filing, correspondence and scheduling for a small team.
[R5] Diploma in Accounting or Business.

Retail Supervisor at Sunrise Mart Pte Ltd (Bishan). Full-time, shift work, including weekends. Run the shop floor with a team of 5 sales staff.
Requirements:
[R1] At least 2 years of retail experience.
[R2] Lead and schedule a team of sales staff.

Cold Chain Logistics Assistant at FrostLink Logistics Pte Ltd (Jurong). Full-time, day shift. Handle chilled and frozen goods in a cold store.
Requirements:
[R1] Experience handling chilled or frozen goods in a cold store.
[R2] Regular stock counts.

[R4] Order picking with a handheld scanner.
